 Azure OpenAI, LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, model evaluation, AI agent design patterns, hallucination mitigation, model monitoring, and governance.
   

  

**AI Platforms**
 Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Services, AI Builder, knowledge platforms, vector databases, and enterprise search patterns.
   

  

**Agentic AI**
 Design of autonomous agents, multi\-agent orchestration, tool use, planning, reasoning, workflow execution, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, and agent monitoring.
   

  

**Programming**
 Python, SQL, .NET / C\#, cloud\-based development, reusable libraries, and automation frameworks.

 Solution architecture, integration architecture, event\-driven design, enterprise application integration, data engineering foundations, security, and observability.

**Position Summary**
**Finance Transformation**

You will collaborate with cross\-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. title: Principal Solution Consultant
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.
   

  

**The Role**
 AspenTech is an AI\-powered software company helping the world’s leading energy, chemical and engineering companies succeed in their digital transformation, making their operations more efficient and reducing impact on the environment. At AspenTech, you will be part of a global market\-leading company with double\-digit growth and a blue\-chip customer base. We offer the opportunity to make an impact, to drive innovation and to be an agent of positive change. Our culture and vision have taken dramatic leaps forward over the past two years and we still have work to do. We need extraordinary individuals to pave the way ahead. We strive to make your story at AspenTech a great one.
   

  

 As a Principal Solution Consultant, you will collaborate closely with AspenTech sales teams to lead consultative discovery sessions, craft visionary solutions, and design strategies tailored to customer needs. Your deep understanding of the industries and coupled with AspenTech's broad product portfolio and value\-enablers will drive opportunities that deliver significant business value to our customers and AspenTech.
   

  

 In this customer\-facing role, you will leverage your technical domain expertise, industry knowledge, and business acumen to position AspenTech solutions effectively.
   

  

**Your Impact**
* Leading and executing the technical qualification of solutions to a business outcome.
* Serving as a discipline/practice subject matter expert with a strong understanding of operational challenges, best practices, and industry trends.
* Learning the complete AspenTech product portfolio to identify and apply products that solve real customer business challenges, including the value of solving those challenges.
* Developing the messaging and materials necessary to position AspenTech solutions in the industry – making adaptations for regional or market differences.
* Partnering closely with Sales Account Managers throughout the sales cycle, from discovery and solution design to executive presentations and deal execution.
* Engaging the senior executive level of customer organisations to paint the vision of how AspenTech can be a partner in their digitalisation journey.
* Developing industry\-specific solutions, aligning technology with measurable business value.
* Providing market input to the Product Management teams to improve solution adoption.
* Identifying and leading sales campaigns to improve AspenTech’s reach, pipeline and awareness.
* Coaching and enabling Sales Account Managers and Solution Consultants on industry\-specific messaging, customer engagement strategies and solution positioning.
* Representing AspenTech at industry conferences, customer forums, webinars and trade events across the region.


 What You'll Need
   

  

* 10\+ years of experience in industrial software, services, solution consulting, presales, technical sales or related customer\-facing technical roles.
* Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering or a related technical discipline (preferred).
* Proficiency in Industrial Data Platforms (Inmation), Historians (IP.21\), and Advanced Process Control (APC) \& Real Time Optimization (RTO) (DMC3, GDOT, Aspen Plus), or equivalent competitor technologies.
* Demonstrated successes in business development.
* Strong ability to bridge technology and business, articulating high\-level technical solutions and their differentiated value.
* Strong drive to convert opportunities into recognised value for customers, with exceptional problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Proficiency in English.
* Must be authorized to work in India without restriction/sponsorship.


**Nice\-to\-Have**
* Services or solution consulting exposure to industries such as Metals \& Mining, LNG, Specialty Chemicals, Pharmaceuticals, Polymers, Consumer Packaged Goods, Food \& Beverage, Pulp \& Paper, Power Generation, and Water \& Wastewater.
* Breadth across several AspenTech solution areas / well\-rounded across multiple disciplines.
* Knowledge of AI/ML solutions and their application in industry.
* Strong understanding of digital transformation initiatives within asset\-intensive industries.
* Working knowledge of Supply Chain/Production Planning \& Scheduling \- Aspen Plant Scheduler, Aspen Unified Planning, or equivalent competitor technologies. Regional travel up to 35%.

Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless.  We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Category Manager - Orthopedic Power Systems
description:
Category Manager \- Orthopedic Power Systems
   

 Location: Pune, Maharashtra
   

 Employment Type: Full\-time
   

 Travel: Extensive domestic travel; occasional international travel
   

  

 1\. Role Purpose
   

  

 The Category Manager – Orthopedic Power Systems will be responsible for building, managing, and growing Manman’s Orthopedic Power Systems business as an independent strategic category.
   

  

 The role will own the complete category lifecycle — from market intelligence, product strategy and portfolio planning to pricing, sales enablement, channel development, marketing, product launches, inventory planning and profitability.
   

  

 The individual will act as the central interface between R\&D, Engineering, Production, Quality \& Regulatory, Sales, Service, Marketing, Finance and Supply Chain, ensuring that the Orthopedic Power Systems portfolio remains clinically relevant, commercially competitive and financially successful.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should combine strong orthopedic product knowledge with commercial and business\-development capability.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 2\. Key Responsibilities
   

  

 A. Category Strategy \& Business Ownership
   

  

 \- Develop and execute the annual and long\-term strategy for the Orthopedic Power Systems category.
   

 \- Own category revenue, gross margin, market share and growth objectives.
   

 \- Develop annual business plans covering:
   

 \- Revenue
   

 \- Unit volumes
   

 \- ASP
   

 \- Gross margin
   

 \- Product mix
   

 \- Channel mix
   

 \- Geographic expansion
   

 \- Identify new market opportunities, customer segments and applications for orthopedic power systems.
   

 \- Develop category growth strategies for India and selected international markets.
   

 \- Track competitors, pricing, technology, product launches and market positioning.
   

 \- Identify gaps in Manman’s portfolio and recommend new products or product variants.
   

  

 B. Product Portfolio Management
   

  

 Own the complete Orthopedic Power Systems portfolio, including relevant:
   

  

 \- High\-speed drill systems
   

 \- Large\-bone systems
   

 \- Small\-bone systems
   

 \- Saw systems
   

 \- Oscillating/sagittal saws
   

 \- Reciprocating saws
   

 \- Shaver systems
   

 \- Endoscopic burr systems
   

 \- Attachments
   

 \- Handpieces
   

 \- Accessories
   

 \- Consumables
   

 \- Batteries and chargers
   

 \- Related service and AMC offerings
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Define product positioning and target customer for each product.
   

 \- Maintain the product portfolio and product lifecycle.
   

 \- Identify products requiring upgrades, replacement or discontinuation.
   

 \- Develop product roadmaps in coordination with R\&D and Engineering.
   

 \- Define product specifications based on market and clinical requirements.
   

 \- Gather voice\-of\-customer and surgeon feedback.
   

 \- Convert clinical requirements into clear product requirements for Engineering/R\&D.
   

  

 C. Product Development \& New Product Introduction
   

  

 \- Prepare Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) for new products.
   

 \- Work with Engineering/R\&D on product development priorities.
   

 \- Coordinate prototype evaluation with surgeons and key opinion leaders.
   

 \- Organize clinical/user evaluations and product trials.
   

 \- Coordinate with Quality \& Regulatory for required documentation and approvals.
   

 \- Develop launch plans for new products.
   

 \- Establish product readiness gates before commercial launch.
   

 \- Coordinate first production, field trials and commercial release.
   

  

 D. Pricing \& Commercial Management
   

  

 \- Develop product pricing strategy based on:
   

 \- Manufacturing cost
   

 \- Landed cost
   

 \- Competitor pricing
   

 \- Clinical value
   

 \- Channel margins
   

 \- Customer segment
   

 \- Market positioning
   

 \- Recommend MRP, distributor/dealer pricing and institutional pricing.
   

 \- Monitor discounting and price realization.
   

 \- Develop tender and institutional pricing frameworks.
   

 \- Identify opportunities to improve category gross margin.
   

 \- Monitor profitability by product, customer segment and channel.
   

  

 E. Sales Enablement
   

  

 Work closely with the Sales team to increase conversion and category penetration.
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Develop sales presentations and product literature.
   

 \- Create product comparison sheets.
   

 \- Develop competitive battle cards.
   

 \- Conduct regular product training for sales teams and distributors.
   

 \- Train sales personnel on clinical applications and product positioning.
   

 \- Support major customer meetings, product demonstrations and evaluations.
   

 \- Participate in important tenders and institutional negotiations.
   

 \- Support the sales team in converting strategic accounts.
   

  

 F. Surgeon \& Key Opinion Leader Engagement
   

  

 Build strong relationships with orthopedic surgeons, hospitals and clinical experts.
   

  

 \- Identify and develop Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs).
   

 \- Conduct surgeon feedback programs.
   

 \- Organize product demonstrations and workshops.
   

 \- Coordinate product evaluations at hospitals.
   

 \- Gather structured feedback on product performance and clinical usability.
   

 \- Identify emerging surgical techniques and applications.
   

 \- Develop surgeon advisory panels where appropriate.
   

 \- Convert clinical feedback into product\-development priorities.
   

  

 G. Channel \& Market Development
   

  

 \- Develop strategies for direct, dealer and distributor channels.
   

 \- Identify and onboard suitable channel partners.
   

 \- Define territory\-wise category opportunities.
   

 \- Develop distributor sales targets and business plans.
   

 \- Monitor distributor inventory and secondary sales.
   

 \- Identify underpenetrated states and territories.
   

 \- Support international expansion of the category where required.
   

 \- Develop market\-entry plans for new countries.
   

  

 H. Marketing \& Category Communication
   

  

 Work with the Marketing team to build the Orthopedic Power Systems brand and category.
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Develop category positioning and messaging.
   

 \- Plan product launches and campaigns.
   

 \- Create clinical and technical marketing content.
   

 \- Develop brochures, catalogues, videos and digital content.
   

 \- Support exhibitions, conferences and workshops.
   

 \- Plan surgeon engagement activities.
   

 \- Develop product demonstrations and educational material.
   

 \- Measure marketing effectiveness and lead conversion.
   

  

 I. Demand Planning \& Inventory
   

  

 Work closely with Sales, Production and Supply Chain to ensure the right product availability.
   

  

 \- Prepare monthly and annual demand forecasts.
   

 \- Translate sales plans into SKU\-level forecasts.
   

 \- Monitor inventory levels and ageing.
   

 \- Identify slow\-moving and obsolete inventory.
   

 \- Coordinate production planning based on demand.
   

 \- Ensure availability of critical handpieces, attachments, batteries and consumables.
   

 \- Monitor forecast accuracy.
   

 \- Work towards improving inventory turns and working capital efficiency.
   

  

 J. Service \& Product Lifecycle Management
   

  

 Work closely with the Service team to improve customer experience and product lifecycle economics.
   

  

 \- Analyse field failures and service complaints.
   

 \- Identify recurring product issues.
   

 \- Coordinate corrective actions with Engineering and Quality.
   

 \- Monitor warranty claims.
   

 \- Develop AMC/service opportunities.
   

 \- Identify opportunities for refurbishment, upgrades and replacement sales.
   

 \- Track installed base and replacement cycles.
   

 \- Develop strategies for consumable and accessory attachment.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 3\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

 The Category Manager will be evaluated on measurable business outcomes including:
   

  

 Commercial
   

  

 \- Category revenue growth
   

 \- Unit sales growth
   

 \- Gross margin
   

 \- Average selling price
   

 \- Price realization
   

 \- Product mix
   

 \- New customer acquisition
   

  

 Market
   

  

 \- Market share growth
   

 \- Number of active hospitals
   

 \- Number of active surgeons/users
   

 \- Geographic penetration
   

 \- Dealer/distributor productivity
   

  

 Product
   

  

 \- New product launches
   

 \- Launch success
   

 \- Product adoption
   

 \- Product lifecycle management
   

 \- Customer satisfaction
   

 \- Product quality feedback
   

  

 Channel
   

  

 \- Active distributors/dealers
   

 \- Distributor sales
   

 \- Secondary sales
   

 \- Dealer productivity
   

 \- Channel inventory
   

  

 Operational
   

  

 \- Forecast accuracy
   

 \- Inventory turns
   

 \- Slow\-moving inventory
   

 \- Product availability
   

 \- Warranty/service performance
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 4\. Cross\-Functional Responsibilities
   

  

 The Category Manager will work closely with:
   

  

 Function\| Primary Interaction
   

 Sales\| Revenue, pipeline, product conversion
   

 Marketing\| Category positioning and campaigns
   

 R\&D / Engineering\| Product development and roadmap
   

 Production\| Costing, capacity and product availability
   

 Quality \& Regulatory\| Compliance and product approvals
   

 Service\| Installed base, failures and lifecycle
   

 Supply Chain\| Forecasting and inventory
   

 Finance\| Pricing, margins and profitability
   

 Management\| Category strategy and business reviews
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 5\. Candidate Profile
   

  

 Education
   

  

 Preferred:
   

  

 \- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Life Sciences, Pharmacy or a related discipline.
   

 \- MBA in Marketing, Product Management or Business Management will be an advantage.
   

  

 Experience
   

  

 5–10 years of relevant experience, preferably in:
   

  

 \- Orthopedic medical devices
   

 \- Surgical instruments
   

 \- Orthopedic power tools
   

 \- Neurosurgical power tools
   

 \- Surgical equipment
   

 \- Medical device product management
   

 \- Medical device sales/business development
   

  

 Candidates with strong experience in orthopedic power tools, surgical drills, saws, shavers or related capital equipment will be preferred.
   

  

 Required Skills
   

  

 \- Strong understanding of orthopedic surgical procedures and applications.
   

 \- Product management experience.
   

 \- Commercial and business\-development orientation.
   

 \- Strong analytical and market\-research capabilities.
   

 \- Understanding of medical\-device distribution.
   

 \- Pricing and margin management.
   

 \- Excellent presentation and communication skills.
   

 \- Ability to interact confidently with orthopedic surgeons.
   

 \- Ability to work with engineering and technical teams.
   

 \- Strong negotiation skills.
   

 \- Willingness to travel extensively.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 6\. Desired Personal Attributes
   

  

 The ideal candidate should be:
   

  

 \- Commercially aggressive but analytically driven
   

 \- Customer and surgeon focused
   

 \- Strong in ownership and execution
   

 \- Comfortable working with ambiguity
   

 \- Data driven
   

 \- Curious about technology
   

 \- Strong at cross\-functional coordination
   

 \- Able to understand both clinical and commercial requirements
   

 \- Comfortable presenting to senior management
   

 \- Willing to spend significant time in the field
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 7\. What Success Looks Like
   

  

 Within the first 12 months, the Category Manager should be able to:
   

  

 1\. Establish a clear strategy for the Orthopedic Power Systems category.
   

 2\. Build a comprehensive competitor and market map.
   

 3\. Define the product portfolio and product roadmap.
   

 4\. Establish SKU\-level sales and demand forecasts.
   

 5\. Improve sales\-team product capability.
   

 6\. Build a structured surgeon/KOL engagement program.
   

 7\. Improve product conversion and market penetration.
   

 8\. Identify new product and portfolio opportunities.
   

 9\. Improve category gross margins and price realization.
   

 10\. Establish a measurable category review system with monthly business dashboards.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 8\. Role Philosophy
   

  

 This is not a conventional Product Manager role.
   

  

 The Category Manager is expected to operate as the business owner of Orthopedic Power Systems, with responsibility extending beyond product specifications into revenue, profitability, market development, customer adoption and portfolio growth.
   

  

 The role requires an individual who can move seamlessly between a surgeon discussion in the morning, a product\-development meeting in the afternoon and a commercial/business review with management in the evening.

title: Partnerships Manager
description:
**About Virohan:** 




 Founded in 2018, by Kunaal Dudeja, Nalin Saluja and Archit Jayaswal, Virohan is an education\-to\-industry partner, shaping the future of healthcare education. It enables India's top universities to deliver best\-in\-class undergraduate programs such as Optometry, MLT, Hospital Administration, OTT, MRIT, and more. Combining cutting\-edge technology, learner\-centric innovations, and strong industry partnerships, Virohan equips students with skills that go beyond degrees, preparing them
 



 for meaningful careers in healthcare. By 2030, Virohan aims to impact a million aspiring healthcare professionals and collaborate with over 100 universities across India to transform education and strengthen healthcare.
 



 We are backed by Blume Ventures, Mynavi Corporation and Rebright Partners (Japan), Elea Foundation and Artha Impact (Switzerland), Yunus Social Business (Germany), AngelList, and Keiretsu Forum, among others. Virohan operates at the intersection of education and Healthcare—two industries that have entered a new phase of rapid growth post\-pandemic. The time to make your mark in this space is now! We’re looking for entrepreneurs to join us in building the next unicorn.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 We are looking for a
 **Manager/Senior Manager – Partnerships \& Alliances** 
 to lead strategic collaborations with top private universities across India.
 



 This is a senior, high\-impact role where you will engage directly with university leadership — Chancellors, Vice Chancellors, Vice Presidents, Directors, and Deans — to forge long\-term, high\-value partnerships. You will be responsible for driving alliances that enable universities to launch and scale Allied Health Science programs through revenue\-sharing models, ensuring both academic excellence and sustainable business growth.
 



 The ideal candidate is a confident relationship builder, a strategic thinker, and a trusted advisor capable of influencing senior stakeholders and translating opportunities into impactful collaborations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**A. Business Development \& Strategic Partnerships** 




 ● Identify and develop partnerships with top\-tier NAAC A, A\+, and A\+\+ private universities across India.
 



 ● Build and maintain a strong pipeline of potential partners and manage the end\-to\-end partnership lifecycle — from outreach and engagement to closure and onboarding.
 



 ● Establish deep, trust\-based relationships with senior university leaders and decision\-makers.
 



 ● Lead partnership discussions and negotiations to secure win\-win agreements aligned with Virohan’s growth goals.
 



**B. Sector \& Market Expertise** 




 ● Develop an in\-depth understanding of Allied Health Sciences and the higher education ecosystem to position yourself as a domain expert.
 



 ● Stay up to date with UGC guidelines, regulatory frameworks, and emerging trends in healthcare education.
 



 ● Monitor market movements and competitive landscape to identify new partnership opportunities and strategic directions.
 



**C. Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 




 ● Work closely with internal teams and partner universities to ensure seamless handover and successful program implementation.
 



 ● Collaborate with Partner Success and Academic teams to deliver exceptional outcomes for universities and students alike.
 



 ● Drive operational excellence and ensure partnerships deliver long\-term value.
 



  





**Experience \& Skills Requirements:** 




 ●
 **3\+ years of experience in B2B sales, strategic partnerships, or account management, preferably engaging with universities or large institutions.** 




 ● Proven success in managing C\-suite or senior academic relationships and closing large, consultative deals.
 



 ● Strong existing network within the higher education ecosystem is highly desirable.
 



 ● Exceptional communication, negotiation, and interpersonal abilities.
 



 ● Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
 



 ● Self\-driven, goal\-oriented, and capable of working independently while collaborating cross functionally.
 



  





**Why Join Us** 




 At Virohan, you’ll play a pivotal role in transforming India’s healthcare education landscape. You’ll work with passionate teams, visionary leaders, and a mission\-driven culture that rewards innovation, ownership, and real\-world impact.

**Weekly off: Any 2 days of the week** 




  





**The Role** 




 We are looking for Senior Event Planners who can own corporate events end to end — from the first client conversation to the final delivery. You will handle the client, sale, proposal, pricing, suppliers and execution for your events.
 



 This is not a coordination role. You will be expected to win business, protect margin, manage the client relationship and deliver what you sold. You will work with corporate clients across the UAE, while coordinating venues and suppliers remotely with local on\-ground support.
 



  





**Key Roles \& Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Own the sale** 



* Manage inbound corporate enquiries from qualification through to closure.
* Understand the client's brief, budget and objectives.
* Build compelling proposals and commercially sound quotations.
* Negotiate, handle objections and close business.
* Follow up consistently and maintain a healthy pipeline.
* Identify opportunities for upsell, repeat business and account growth.

* Response time
* Delivery quality
* Client satisfaction

 You should know where you stand and what needs to improve without waiting for someone else to tell you.

 of experience in corporate events, MICE, banquet sales, hotel events, event

**fundamentals and how quickly you learn**

title: Secure by Supplier Cyber Security Consultant
description:
**Who We Are**
 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
   

  

 As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
   

  

 We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
   

  

 \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture
   

  

**About This Role**
 We are seeking a Secure by Supplier Cyber Security Consultant to help embed secure\-by\-design principles into supplier engagements from the earliest stages of the supplier lifecycle. This role focuses on identifying, assessing and mitigating cyber security and regulatory risks associated with third\-party suppliers, while ensuring compliance with UK Telecom Security Regulations and Vodafone’s internal security standards.
   

  

 The successful candidate will work closely with business, technology and supplier stakeholders to evaluate supplier security postures, provide risk\-based security recommendations, influence sourcing decisions, and support the inclusion of appropriate contractual controls. This is an opportunity to play a key role in protecting Vodafone’s supply chain while enabling secure and compliant business operations.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Perform technical assessments of supplier security capabilities and regulatory compliance during supplier sourcing and contracting activities
* Evaluate security and compliance risks using a standardised assessment methodology and identify effective mitigation measures
* Provide security recommendations to support supplier selection and sourcing decisions
* Engage with external suppliers to understand, validate and influence their security and regulatory compliance positions
* Collaborate with internal subject matter experts and stakeholders to verify supplier security positions and support effective decision\-making
* Act as the technical security specialist when communicating cyber security risks to business, technology and supplier stakeholders
* Support supplier contract negotiations by identifying technical security requirements and recommending contractual controls to minimise risk
* Develop, maintain and improve relevant processes, reporting and assessment tools
* Provide guidance on cyber security and compliance\-related matters to internal colleagues and suppliers
* Promote security as a business enabler and support the adoption of secure\-by\-design principles across supplier engagements
* Ensure suppliers understand and adhere to Vodafone’s security standards and regulatory obligations


**Who You Are**
* Experience working in a pre\-sales, sourcing, risk assessment or supplier security environment, evaluating responses and determining security recommendations
* Strong ability to communicate security requirements, risks and mitigation measures to both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Good understanding of networking concepts, traffic flows, network architecture and security best practices
* Experience managing and influencing stakeholders across different levels of an organisation
* Significant professional experience in information technology and cyber security, ideally within supplier risk, security assurance or governance roles
* Knowledge of cloud security, web services security, container security, connectivity, identity and access management, network security and penetration testing concepts
* Understanding of security governance across Software as a Service (SaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS) and Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) environments
* Expertise across telecommunications technologies including:
+ Switching and routing technologies
+ Routers, modems and Optical Network Terminals (ONTs)
+ Radio Access Networks (RAN)
+ Core routers, firewalls and border gateways
+ Mobile devices, tablets and IoT environments
+ Mobile Private Networks (MPN) using 4G/5G technologies

* University degree in Information Security or an equivalent discipline
* One or more recognised industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, GIAC, TOGAF, SABSA or equivalent
* 5\+ years of experience in cyber security


**Not a perfect fit?**
 Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
   

  

**What's In It For You**
* Opportunity to influence supplier security decisions across a global telecommunications environment
* Exposure to complex cyber security, supplier assurance and regulatory compliance challenges
* Collaboration with business, technology and cyber security specialists across multiple functions
* Ability to contribute directly to Vodafone’s supply chain security strategy and risk reduction objectives
* Experience working with evolving telecom security regulations and industry\-leading security practices
* Opportunity to shape secure\-by\-design adoption across supplier ecosystems


**What Skills You Will Learn**
* Advanced supplier cyber security assessment and assurance techniques
* Regulatory compliance evaluation, including UK Telecom Security requirements
* Security risk quantification, recommendation development and risk mitigation planning
* Contractual security control evaluation and negotiation support
* Supplier governance and third\-party risk management practices
* Stakeholder management and executive\-level security communication
* Telecom network security across fixed, mobile and emerging technology environments
* Security governance across cloud, SaaS, PaaS and IaaS delivery models


**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
 Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.
   

  

**Join Us**
 At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
   

  

 We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
   

  

 With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

 Master's Degree

title: Account Development Representative
description:
What You'll Do
   

  

 Avalara is hiring Account Development Representatives (ADRs) to help increase growth by creating conversations with prospective customers, building interest in our products, and generating new pipeline opportunities for our sales team through outbound prospecting.
   

  

 This is more than an entry\-level sales role. It is a starting point for individuals who want to build sales skills, perform in a high\-expectation environment, and grow their careers over time.
   

  

 At Avalara, we believe in promoting from within. If you want to learn sales fundamentals, put in the work, respond to coaching, and grow your career, then the ADR roles is for you.
   

  

**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**
* As an ADR, you will build the top of our sales funnel. You will prospect into target accounts, open doors with new partners, create momentum with prospects, and turn outreach into business opportunities.
* Every day you will initiate conversations with prospective customers, create interest in Avalara solutions, and create new pipeline through outbound outreach.
* You will qualify opportunities, handle objections, and schedule meetings for the sales team.
* Research accounts, identify buying signals, and build an understanding of Avalara's products, customers, and market
* Partner with Account Executives and sales leadership on account strategy, persona targeting, and pipeline creation
* You will use sales engagement, CRM, AI, and other tools to manage outreach, maintain operating discipline, and support webinars, events, and other demand generation plans when relevant
* Achieve monthly performance goals tied to activity quality, meetings, pipeline creation, and continuous improvement through feedback


 What You’ll Need To Be Successful
   

  

* You're looking for more than just a job—you want to build a meaningful, long\-term career.
* You have 4–10 years of professional experience in sales or other metrics\-driven environments.
* You're motivated to grow your career in sales and enjoy creating opportunities from the ground up.
* You're resilient, embrace challenges, and are willing to put in the effort every day, learn from rejection, and continuously improve your skills.
* You thrive on learning, personal growth, new opportunities, and the excitement of outbound prospecting.


**Work Location \& Schedule**
* This is an onsite role based in Pune.
* You'll work from the office five days a week, from 6:30 PM to 3:30 AM IST.
* You will report directly to Sales Manager


 Avalara is an AI\-first Company
   

  

 AI is embedded in our workflows, decision\-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
   

  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI\-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges \- improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.


 How We’ll Take Care Of You
   

  

 Total Rewards
   

  

 In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
   

  

 Health \& Wellness
   

  

 Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
   

  

 Inclusive culture and diversity
   

  

 Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee\-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
   

  

**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
 We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
   

  

 We’ve already built an industry\-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6\.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real \- we're a billion dollar business \- and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission \- to be part of every transaction in the world.
   

  

 We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
   

  

**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
 Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Manager / Assistant Manager - Estimation
description:
**About Zeeco**
 Zeeco is a global leader in advanced combustion and environmental solutions, delivering innovative technologies for the refining, petrochemical, chemical, LNG, power, pharmaceutical, and allied process industries. Our portfolio includes process burners, power burners, boiler burners, duct burners, thermal oxidizers, flares, vapor recovery systems, incinerators, and combustion control systems. With engineering and manufacturing facilities across the globe, Zeeco provides customized combustion solutions that meet the highest standards of safety, efficiency, and environmental compliance.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Zeeco is seeking an experienced
 **Senior Estimation Engineer** 
 with
 **10 to 15\+ years of experience** 
 in preparing techno\-commercial estimates for industrial burner systems. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical knowledge of combustion equipment, burner management systems, instrumentation, mechanical equipment, and project costing.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be responsible for reviewing customer enquiries, interpreting technical specifications, coordinating with engineering and procurement teams, obtaining vendor quotations, developing accurate cost estimates, and preparing competitive technical and commercial proposals for global projects.
   

  

 Candidates with either a
 **Mechanical Engineering** 
 or
 **Instrumentation \& Control Engineering** 
 background and extensive experience in industrial combustion equipment are encouraged to apply.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**RFQ \& Technical Review**
* Review customer RFQs, ITBs, specifications, datasheets, PFDs, P\&IDs, burner schedules, and other project documents.
* Evaluate process requirements, fuel characteristics, combustion duty, control philosophy, emissions, and applicable design standards.
* Identify technical clarifications, scope gaps, deviations, and commercial risks before proposal submission.


**Estimation \& Costing**
* Prepare accurate techno\-commercial estimates for industrial burner packages.
* Develop Bills of Materials (BOM) covering burners, fuel trains, BMS/CCS, PLC/HMI, instrumentation, valves, electrical, mechanical, and bought\-out items.
* Estimate engineering, fabrication, assembly, testing, logistics, commissioning, and documentation costs.


**Vendor \& Proposal Management**
* Obtain and evaluate vendor quotations for technical compliance, pricing, and delivery.
* Coordinate with procurement to optimize vendor selection and project costing.
* Prepare technical and commercial proposals, including cost sheets, assumptions, exclusions, and deviations.


**Engineering Coordination**
* Coordinate with Mechanical, Process, Electrical, Instrumentation, Procurement, and Manufacturing teams to validate technical and commercial inputs.
* Review engineering deliverables such as P\&IDs, GA drawings, wiring diagrams, and instrument schedules to support accurate estimation.


**Cost Optimization \& Bid Support**
* Identify value engineering opportunities and cost\-effective technical solutions while ensuring compliance with customer specifications.
* Support customer clarification meetings, bid evaluations, negotiations, and project handover following order award.


**Estimation Database**
* Maintain estimation databases, standard costing, historical pricing, and vendor cost records to improve estimation accuracy and proposal competitiveness.


**Technical Expertise**
**The ideal candidate should possess strong knowledge of:**
**Combustion Systems**
* Process, Boiler, Power, and Duct Burners
* Low NOx, Ultra Low NOx, Gas, Oil, Dual\-Fuel, and Multi\-Fuel Burners
* Burner sizing, fuel selection, combustion principles, and emissions requirements


**Fuel Train \& Mechanical Systems:**
* Fuel gas and liquid fuel trains
* Pressure regulators, safety shut\-off valves, control valves, vent valves, filters, and strainers
* Burners, dampers, registers, skid\-mounted systems, piping, and fabricated assemblies


**Instrumentation \& Controls:**
* Burner Management Systems (BMS) and Combustion Control Systems (CCS)
* PLC/HMI\-based control systems
* Flame scanners, ignition systems, pressure, temperature, and flow instrumentation
* Control valves, actuators, and combustion safety interlocks


**Estimation \& Proposal Engineering:**
* Interpretation of RFQs, P\&IDs, datasheets, burner schedules, and technical specifications
* Preparation of Bills of Materials (BOM), vendor enquiries, techno\-commercial evaluations, and detailed cost estimates
* Cost optimization, value engineering, and proposal preparation for industrial burner packages


**Codes \& Standards:**
 Working knowledge of applicable combustion and industrial standards, including
 **NFPA 85/86** 
 ,
 **API** 
 ,
 **ASME** 
 ,
 **IEC** 
 , and
 **ISA is preferred.**
**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or Instrumentation \& Control Engineering.
* 10–15 years of experience in estimation, proposal engineering, or applications engineering for industrial combustion systems.
* Experience working with burner OEMs, combustion equipment manufacturers, EPC companies, or industrial heating solution providers.


**Preferred Industry Background**
* Industrial Burner Manufacturers
* Combustion Equipment OEMs
* Boiler Manufacturers
* Process Heater OEMs
* Furnace Manufacturers
* Oil \& Gas
* Petrochemical
* Refining
* Power Generation
* EPC Organizations
* Industrial Heating Equipment Manufacturers


**Desired Competencies**

* Excellent understanding of combustion systems and process heating applications.
* Ability to interpret complex customer specifications and translate them into accurate cost estimates.
* Strong analytical and cost modelling skills.
* Excellent negotiation and vendor management capabilities.
* High proficiency in Microsoft Excel and ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, or equivalent).
* Ability to manage multiple enquiries with tight bid submission deadlines.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Self\-driven with a strong focus on accuracy, quality, and continuous improvement.

title: Manager – Donor Relations Management
description:
**Company Overview:** 
 Bharatiya Jain Sanghatana is a non\-profit organisation dedicated to nation\-building through impactful social development, disaster response, environmental stewardship, and educational initiatives since 1985\. With a strong nationwide presence and an active volunteer network, BJS works collaboratively with governments, communities and partners to design and implement sustainable solutions to pressing societal challenges. The organization’s mission is to identify relevant social concerns, develop meaningful interventions and ensure their effective, scalable implementation across the country.
 



  





**Job Summary:** 
 The Manager – Donor Relations Management will play a crucial role in strengthening and expanding strategic partnerships with corporates, CSR foundations, philanthropic institutions and other relevant stakeholders to support BJS’ mission and programmes. The role combines strategic engagement, relationship management, proposal development, impact communication and effective coordination across functions to drive resource mobilization and deepen partner engagement.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**(a) Partnership Strategy \& Outreach:** 




  Research, identify and engage potential partners whose priorities align with BJS’ mission, programmes and impact goals.
 



  Support development of tailored engagement strategies for prospective donors.
 



  Assist in developing high\-quality concept notes, proposals, partnership decks and budgets for effective donor engagement.
 



**(b) Donor Engagement \& Relationship Management:** 




  Build and nurture long\-term relationships with existing and prospective donor partners.
 



  Coordinate meetings, presentations and follow\-up conversations with all stakeholders to progress partnership engagements.
 



  Work with programme teams to capture impact data, success stories and case studies for donor engagement and reporting purposes.
 



  Support programme teams in developing proposals, concept notes, and strategic project documentation.
 



**(c) Donor Reporting \& Compliance:** 




  Prepare high\-quality, timely and accurate donor reports (monthly, quarterly, annual) as per agreed formats and timelines with various donor partners.
 



  Coordinate with programme and finance teams to collect utilization data, impact metrics and supporting documentation.
 



  Ensure compliance with donor agreements, MoUs and CSR reporting requirements.
 



  Closely track grant milestones, deliverables and utilisation schedules to avoid delays and non\-compliance.
 



  Maintain complete documentation of agreements, amendments, invoices and reporting records related to all donor/partner engagements.
 



**(d) Donor Database \& Systems Management:** 




  Maintain and regularly update donor databases, CRM systems, and grant trackers.
 



  Monitor key donor timelines, renewal cycles and reporting calendars.
 



  Develop structured trackers for grant utilization and partnership commitments.
 



**(e) Partner and Stakeholder Engagement:** 




  Serve as a bridge between partners, programme and finance teams to ensure execution of donor commitments.
 



  Support the leadership/management with data, summaries and briefing notes for various donor engagements.
 



  Assist in developing donor engagement SOPs and internal reporting systems.
 



  





**Qualifications and Experience:** 




  





  Master’s degree in development studies, Social Work, Management, or a related field.
 



  Minimum 5 to 8 years of relevant experience in donor management, CSR partnerships, grant management or institutional fundraising within the social development/non\-profit sector.
 



  Understanding of CSR compliance frameworks and grant management processes.
 



  





**Key Skills and Competencies:** 




  





  Excellent verbal and written communication abilities in English and Hindi. Working knowledge of Marathi a plus.
 



  Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (for grant tracking, utilisation analysis) and PowerPoint (for donor presentations).
 



  Ability to manage multiple donor accounts simultaneously with structured planning.
 



  High level of integrity, empathy, and alignment with service\-oriented values.
 



  Ability to work sensitively within a mission\-driven, values\-based organization. Personal Attributes:
 



  Deep commitment and passion for social impact.
 



  High sense of ownership and accountability.
 



  Proactive, organized and deadline conscious.
 



  Relationship\-oriented with strong interpersonal skills.
 



  





**To Apply:** 




 Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume and a cover letter explaining their suitability for the role to
 **Agarg@bjsindia.org** 
 with the subject line "
 **Application for Manager \-** 
**Donor Relations Management \-** 
**Pune".**

description:
**Job Summary**
 Provides comprehensive application functionality, configuration and support expertise for application software solutions; works with business analysts, architects, technical experts and software vendors on the solution requirements, design, configuration, functionality gap resolution, implementation, support, maintenance and enhancement of the applications.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Analyzes and evaluates application functionality and provides recommendations to increase utilization of standard application functionality to improve business processes and capabilities Determines and documents optimum application setup and configuration to meet functional requirements and specifications; configures and verifies application setup and configuration Develops expertise in emerging application and solution trends and functionality; provides functional recommendations for assigned applications and systems. Conducts analysis of potential application solutions, identifies and recommends solutions to address functionality gaps in the application. Develops and maintains strong relationships with relevant vendors; works with vendors to improve application functionality and resolve functionality issues Partners with process owners, business analysts, systems analysts and architects to gather, document and review functional, architecture and technical requirements and define application functional designs. Serves as subject matter expert and point of contact on content, processes, procedures and functionality associated with assigned applications for projects and application support (as needed). Creates and manages functional specifications for a given project from which programs and configurations will be applied to create the program, application, or complete solution
   

  

**Competencies**
 Business insight \- Applying knowledge of business and the marketplace to advance the organization’s goals.
   

  

 Customer focus \- Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer\-centric solutions.
   

  

 Global perspective \- Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.
   

  

 Manages complexity \- Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
   

  

 Manages conflict \- Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.
   

  

 Optimizes work processes \- Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.
   

  

 Tech savvy \- Anticipating and adopting innovations in business\-building digital and technology applications.
   

  

 Solution Configuration \- Configures, creates and tests a solution for commercial off\-the\-shelf (COTS) applications using industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
   

  

 Solution Design \- Creates and defines the solution design complete with instrumentation and measurement, using industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to synthesize diagrams, models and documentation in order to build a solution that meets buildability, business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
   

  

 Solution Functional Fit Analysis \- Composes and decomposes a system into its component parts using procedures, tools and work aides for the purpose of studying how well the component parts were designed, purchased and configured to interact holistically to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
   

  

 Solution Modeling \- Creates, designs and formulates models, diagrams and documentation using industry standards, tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
   

  

 Solution Validation Testing \- Validates a configuration item change or solution using the Function's defined best practices, including the Systems Development Life Cycle (SDLC) standards, tools and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.
   

  

 Values differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
   

  

**Education, Licenses, Certifications**
 College, university, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or related subject, or relevant equivalent experience required. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
   

  

**Experience**
 Minimum 12 years of experience required
   

  

**Functional Responsibilities**
* Manage requirement gathering workshops with Finance and business stakeholders.
* Analyze business processes and recommend Oracle Financials solutions.
* Configure and support Oracle EBS Financial modules:
* General Ledger (GL)
* Accounts Payable (AP)
* Accounts Receivable (AR)
* Fixed Assets (FA)
* Cash Management (CM)
* Subledger Accounting (SLA)
* Cost Management
* India Localization (GST/TDS)
* Audit Vault \& Database Firewall (Audit Trail)

**Job Description \- Strategy \& Transactions – Strategy (Sr. Consultant)** 
**At Deloitte Strategy \& Transactions (S\&T), we don’t just advise — we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth.** 
**We work with C\-suite executives, Boards, and business leaders to answer the questions that matter most — from navigating complex M\&A and driving digital transformation, to reshaping operating models and unlocking new market opportunities. * Technology Strategy \& Alignment – Delivering Technology Strategy, driven both from a top\-down analysis starting with an articulated business strategy and a bottom\-up technology capability analysis; Experience working on cost reduction techniques, portfolio modernization and delivery roadmap creation within Consumer Industry
* Cloud Strategy – Understand the impact of cloud computing through hybrid cloud, data centers, cloud strategy in business and technology decisions, ability to identify and articulate the business and technology drivers of cloud computing across industries, design of business cases for cloud. Certifications such as AWS, GCP, Azure will be a plus. Experience with workload assessment, business cases development, operational assessment, roadmap creation, vendor selection for companies in Consumer space
* Technology Operating Model Design \- Assessment of current state operating model, ability to identify pain points and process gaps; design of target state operating model and associated roadmap for leading companies in Consumer Industry
* Enterprise Architecture – Experience of Enterprise Architecture capabilities such as Blueprinting, solution architecture, architecture assessment, planning and cost estimation. Knowledge of any of the major Enterprise Architecture Frameworks (preferred) E.g., TOGAF, FEA(F), and DoDAF.
* Technology Outsourcing \- Experience working on Technology Outsourcing model, vendor analysis and benchmarking, contract analysis and understanding of how IT resources create shareholder (business) value within Consumer Industry
* AI/ML – Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts and frameworks, ability to design solutions around automation including advanced AI / ML solutions in areas of deep learning, machine learning, NLP, Simulation etc.; knowledge of AI/ML implementation use cases within Consumer Industry
* GenAI – Knowledge and experience in GenAI concepts, landscape (E.g., OpenAI, Microsoft Azure Cognitive Services, NVIDIA AI Foundations, GPT3 etc.) use cases across relevant industries and ability to assess GenAI fitment based on client demands within Consumer Industry
* DevOps / Agile – Strong understanding of Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, Site Reliability Engineering with hands on experience on tools such as Jenkins, Git and JIRA
* Strong understanding of front\-to\-back architecture principles, technology stack, infrastructure with exposure to new age tools
* One life cycle project execution experience in recommending and/or implementing Technology strategy and solutions for improving business outcomes
* Ability to articulate leading business issues and trends including the associated technology implications within Consumer Industry
* Demonstrate application of business acumen while leveraging information technology
* Exposure to working in non\-India Geographies (preferably the US) and / or interacting with Global stakeholders


**Core Consulting**
* Communication: Ability to conduct client interviews, facilitate workshops and training sessions, and present findings and recommendations clearly and concisely
* Client Presence: Proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships with clients and cross\-functional team members
* Analytical Thinking: Proficiency in quantitative analysis, primary and secondary research, and business case development; ability to synthesize data into actionable insights and recommendations. Strong command of analytical and productivity tools including Microsoft Excel (financial modeling, data analysis) and PowerPoint (storyboarding, executive\-level presentations) is a plus
* Structured Problem Solving: Logical, hypothesis\-driven approach to problem solving with demonstrated ability to perform root cause analysis
* Delivery Excellence: Deadline\-oriented and quality\-focused; capable of owning end\-to\-end delivery of high\-quality work products, managing workstreams, developing engagement plans, and mentoring junior team members
* Collaboration: Comfortable working independently and within teams across all levels; able to prioritize effectively, manage scope changes, handle multiple assignments simultaneously, and escalate issues proactively
* Networking: Self\-starter with the ability to navigate career growth and build a strong internal and external professional network

title: Territory head
description:

For nearly a decade, the company has supported SME enterprises, manufacturers, distributors, dealers, retailers, and exporters across India with tailored financing solutions.  **Director \- Solution Architecture**

This is a senior, client\-facing leadership role focused on designing scalable solutions, driving complex implementations, translating business and regulatory requirements into technology capabilities, and ensuring successful enterprise adoption.
   

  

 The role will work closely with senior client stakeholders, product, engineering, implementation, operations, and commercial teams. You will own solution architecture across the full lifecycle—from discovery and solution design through implementation, go\-live, optimization, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines strong healthcare domain expertise with enterprise architecture, implementation leadership, stakeholder management, and the ability to translate complex operational requirements into practical, scalable technology solutions.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Enterprise Solution Architecture**
* Own solution architecture for a portfolio of strategic enterprise healthcare accounts from initial discovery through implementation and steady state
* Understand complex client workflows, business objectives, operational challenges, regulatory requirements, and technology environments
* Design scalable, secure, and configurable solutions that address multi\-site, multi\-state, and multi\-payer requirements
* Translate business and operational requirements into detailed solution architectures, workflows, integrations, configurations, and implementation plans
* Serve as the senior architectural counterpart to client technology, operations, finance, and business leadership

**Healthcare Revenue Cycle \& Domain Architecture**
* Apply strong knowledge of US healthcare revenue cycle processes to solution design, particularly outpatient and professional billing environments
* Translate requirements related to payer rules, claims processing, denials, eligibility, payment posting, reimbursement, and revenue cycle workflows into scalable technology solutions
* Understand healthcare transactions and standards including 837, 835, 270/271, 277CA, EDI, ERA, and payer enrollment
* Incorporate requirements related to CMS\-1500, UB\-04, claim edits, NCCI logic, modifiers, therapy\-specific billing rules, claim scrubbing, remit reconciliation, and payment workflows
* Evaluate regulatory and payer changes and assess their implications for product architecture, integrations, and solution design
* Identify recurring operational or billing issues and work with product and engineering teams to address root causes through platform capabilities rather than manual intervention


**Enterprise Pre\-Sales \& Solution Consulting**
* Act as the senior solution architecture expert during enterprise sales pursuits, RFPs, discovery sessions, technical evaluations, and client presentations
* Lead solution discovery with prospective clients to understand business, operational, technical, and integration requirements
* Define what can realistically be delivered within existing product and technical capabilities and identify areas requiring customization or product enhancement
* Develop solution proposals, architecture approaches, implementation assumptions, integration strategies, and technical responses for enterprise opportunities
* Partner with sales and commercial teams to ensure technical commitments are accurate, achievable, and clearly documented
* Ensure requirements are captured effectively and handed over to implementation teams without unnecessary re\-discovery or ambiguity


**Product \& Technology Strategy**
* Translate enterprise customer requirements into actionable product and engineering requirements
* Partner with product leadership to influence roadmap priorities based on recurring customer needs, market requirements, and healthcare industry changes
* Identify opportunities to improve platform scalability, configurability, automation, interoperability, and operational efficiency
* Evaluate opportunities to leverage automation and AI across healthcare workflows and revenue cycle processes
* Establish reusable architectural standards and patterns that enable faster implementation of future enterprise accounts
* Contribute to technical documentation, solution standards, architecture guidelines, and organizational knowledge repositories


**Cross\-Functional Leadership**
* Work effectively across product, engineering, implementation, operations, sales, finance, compliance, and customer\-facing teams
* Lead through influence across cross\-functional teams without relying solely on direct reporting structures
* Provide architectural guidance and mentorship to solution architects, implementation teams, and other technical stakeholders
* Establish clear ownership, decision\-making frameworks, escalation paths, and delivery standards for complex solutions
* Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders


**Architecture Governance \& Performance**
* Establish and maintain architecture standards, design principles, integration patterns, and solution governance processes
* Review proposed solutions for scalability, security, reliability, interoperability, and maintainability
* Monitor implementation and solution performance and identify opportunities for optimization
* Use data and operational insights to identify recurring issues, evaluate solution effectiveness, and drive improvements
* Ensure enterprise solutions meet agreed business outcomes, technical standards, and implementation timelines


 What We're Looking For
   

  

**Must\-Have**
* 12\-16 years of experience in solution architecture, enterprise architecture, healthcare technology, revenue cycle technology, or related domains
* Strong experience designing and implementing enterprise healthcare solutions for large, multi\-site or multi\-state provider organizations
* Deep understanding of US healthcare revenue cycle processes, including professional billing, commercial insurance, Medicare/Medicaid, claims, denials, appeals, and payment workflows
* Strong working knowledge of healthcare interoperability and transaction standards, including EDI, 837, 835, 270/271, 277CA, and ERA
* Experience leading complex implementations involving multiple systems, integrations, locations, states, and payer requirements
* Strong understanding of healthcare technology environments, including EMR/EHR, practice management, RCM, and healthcare SaaS platforms
* Excellent spoken and written English with the ability to independently lead executive\-level business and technical discussions with US\-based clients
* Strong stakeholder management and cross\-functional leadership skills
* Ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable technical architectures and actionable implementation plans
* Data\-driven and structured approach to problem\-solving, architecture decisions, and solution optimization
* Comfortable working with teams and clients across US Eastern Time Zone working hours


**Strong Preference**

* Experience with multi\-state Medicaid or workers' compensation environments

**Nice to Have**

* Pre\-sales, solutions consulting, technical sales, or product management experience

 Infrastructure Design Services is a team of Technology Architects and Engineers responsible for the analysis and design of the infrastructure framework to fit the application, platform or system needs in\-line with MasterCard's operational standards and principles.
   

  

 Infrastructure Design Services is engaged from the beginning of the analysis and design phase to work with the application team(s) and other critical teams within Mastercard to ensure that the completed infrastructure and application architecture aligns with MasterCard’s security, scalability and availability standards.
   

  

 Infrastructure Design Services' primary deliverable is the TAD (Technical Architecture Document) which details the infrastructure design for the application, platform or system.

 This job actively performs designing and delivering internet infrastructure solutions that satisfy member, product, service and backbone requirements.
   

  

 Have you ever worked with Microsoft Visio to design middleware infrastructure from the ground up?
   

  

 Can you interface with the user(s), application team(s), etc., and all other stakeholders in order to determine their (evolving) needs and requirements?
   

  

 Can you generate the highest level of system requirements, based on the given requirements and other constraints?
   

  

 Can you ensure that this set of high level requirements is consistent, complete, correct, and operationally defined?
   

  

 Role
   

  

* Generating requirements, together with other architects, engineers, application team(s) and user(s), to determine that all of the high level requirements have been met.
* Generating products such as TADs, technical documents, logical flows, and models to keep the user(s), architects and the engineers constantly up to date and in agreement on the application, system or platform to be provided as it is evolving.
* Ensuring that all architectural products and products with architectural input are maintained in the most current state and never allowed to become obsolete.

* Thorough knowledge and understanding of network, operating system principles and web middleware.
* Thorough knowledge in one or more core functions related to internet infrastructure design and/or web administration

* Working knowledge of Database technologies.
* Working knowledge of cloud technologies
* Must be high\-energy, proactive, detail\-oriented and able to function under pressure in an independent environment.
* Must have a high degree of initiative and self\-motivation and demonstrate the ability to drive results.
* Strong communication skills both verbal and written and strong relationship and collaborative skills and organizational skills with the ability to work as a member of matrix based diverse and geographically distributed project team.
* Willingness and ability to learn and take on challenging opportunities is critical.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust Architecture principles and Network Micro\-segmentation.
* Experience working with YAML based deployments

* Displays leadership and initiative.
* Detailed oriented and customer obsessed.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to multi\-task and prioritize efforts.
* Ability to pick up new technologies at a quick pace and learn on\-the\-go
* Ability to work with team members located in multiple geographies

* Provide positive customer service to internal business partners.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

description:

title: SAP Vistex Functional
description:
**Job Summary**
 This role is for a Functional Lead with six to ten years of experience in SAP VISTEX FUNCTIONAL RESOURCE and related modules in a hybrid work model with rotational shifts and no travel requirement. The position focuses on optimizing end to end SAP OTC processes including advanced order management batch management and regional configurations for Brazil and Latin America to improve operational efficiency enhance customer experience and support sustainable business growth.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive end to end design and optimization of SAP VISTEX FUNCTIONAL RESOURCE by aligning system capabilities with business objectives to deliver reliable and efficient transaction flows across global operations.
* Oversee functional configuration of SAP basic information systems and advanced order to cash functionalities to ensure accurate master data pricing conditions and document flows that support robust business performance.
* Manage advanced order management scenarios including complex order types fulfillment constraints and allocation rules so that customer commitments are met consistently and on time.
* Coordinate integration of SAP materials management batch management features with sales and distribution processes to maintain precise batch tracking compliance and inventory visibility.
* Provide expert functional analysis of Brazil and Latin America specific SAP sales and distribution requirements including regional taxation invoicing and legal compliance to minimize risk and rework.
* Collaborate closely with cross functional stakeholders in supply chain finance and operations to translate business needs into clear SAP functional specifications and actionable configuration tasks.
* Guide the design of scalable and resilient hybrid process solutions that support rotational shift operations by ensuring system availability streamlined workflows and simple user interactions.
* Conduct comprehensive impact assessments for change requests and enhancements by validating requirements performing fit gap analysis and recommending solutions that protect overall process integrity.
* Support testing cycles by preparing test scenarios executing functional tests and validating results so that deployments occur with minimal defects and stable performance in production.
* Develop detailed functional documentation including process flows configuration rationales and user guidance to promote consistent adoption and future maintainability of SAP solutions.
* Enable continuous improvement by monitoring key performance indicators related to order fulfillment billing accuracy and batch management and by proposing data driven enhancements that support sustainable growth.
* Coach users and process owners through workshops and knowledge sharing sessions to improve understanding of SAP OTC capabilities and to encourage efficient and compliant usage across teams.
* Align daily functional activities with company purpose by ensuring that customer orders are processed accurately and transparently thereby contributing to trust in commercial relationships and positive societal impact through dependable supply chains.


**Qualifications**
* Demonstrate strong hands on expertise in SAP order to cash processes including basic information systems configuration advanced order to cash features and end to end sales cycle management.
* Possess practical experience in advanced SAP order management including complex order types credit checks fulfillment strategies and integration with downstream logistics and billing.
* Show solid proficiency in SAP materials management batch management including batch creation tracking allocation and integration with sales and distribution for compliant product traceability.
* Bring applied knowledge of SAP sales and distribution processes for Brazil and Latin America including regional tax structures invoicing rules and statutory reporting requirements.
* Apply domain awareness in transportation and logistics by understanding shipment planning carrier collaboration and delivery execution to ensure that SAP designs reflect realistic operational flows.
* Utilize exposure to industrial manufacturing environments to shape configurations that support discrete or process production demand management and reliable order promising.
* Operate comfortably in a hybrid work setup and rotational shifts while maintaining clear communication structured documentation and consistent support coverage for business stakeholders.
* Leverage strong analytical and problem solving abilities to diagnose process and configuration issues quickly propose practical remediation steps and validate sustainable solutions.
* Use effective collaboration and communication skills to work with functional and technical teams ensuring that designs integrations and test outcomes are clearly understood and jointly owned.
* Maintain commitment to quality and compliance by following internal standards regulatory expectations and audit ready documentation practices in all SAP functional activities.
* Embrace a mindset of continuous learning by staying informed about SAP advancements regional regulatory changes and industry leading practices relevant to order to cash and logistics.
